title: 第17章 只要这片温暖还在她便不介意第18章 水火亦能相济
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
宗门小比上的惊鸿一现，如同在平静的湖面投下巨石，“杳杳师姐”
的名号彻底响彻青云宗内外门。
炼气五层轻败七层，甚至能随口指点对方功法瓶颈，这等手段已远超寻常弟子理解范畴。
羡慕、敬畏、嫉妒、探究…各种目光交织在她那身不变的蓝色衣裙上。
云杳杳却浑不在意，赛后便溜去了灵兽园，对着毛茸茸的灵禽幼崽研究了半天“可持续性撸毛与投喂方案”
，最后在灵兽园执事弟子快要哭出来的目光中，遗憾地放弃了领养一只看起来就很好吃…很可爱的云翅鸟雏鸟的想法，只买了几斤据说肉质鲜嫩的灵鱼回忘忧峰涮火锅。
日子似乎又恢复了之前的节奏。
她依旧每日穿着蓝衣在各峰乱窜，时而去丹堂“优化”
丹方（主要提升口味），时而去器阁“指点”
炼器（主要改进厨具），时而去符殿“讨论”
符箓（主要增加生活便利性），偶尔还会去讲法堂蹭课，听得困了就趴在桌上打瞌睡，偏偏还能在长老提问时迷迷糊糊说出些一针见血、让人茅塞顿开的见解，惹得讲法长老又爱又恨。
三位师兄对她更是宠得没边。
炎铮三天两头给她送新炼制的、功能奇特（但造型往往一言难尽）的法器；石猛变着花样给她做药膳滋补；连冷面大师兄顾沧溟，也会在她去金霆峰蹭剑术课时，破例亲自指点她几句——虽然方式是用剑气把她逼得满场乱窜，美其名曰“实战感悟”
云杳杳乐在其中。
她刻意收敛了所有非凡之处，纯粹以炼气五层的修为去学习、去体验、去感受。
她发现，当心中有了牵挂和温暖，不再是为了变强而变强，而是为了守护这份平静去修炼时，每一个小境界的突破，每一次对术法的新理解，都带着一种前所未有的充实和喜悦。
这与第一世孤冷前行、唯力量至上的感觉，截然不同。
然而，树大招风。
她越是表现得轻松写意，暗地里的窥探便越多。
这日，她刚从阵峰出来（去研究了如何给火锅设一个恒温保鲜阵），打算去外门坊市逛逛有没有新奇的调料，却敏锐地察觉到一丝极细微的、带着恶意的窥视感。

那感觉一闪而逝，隐匿得极好，若非她神魂本质极高，根本无从察觉。
云杳杳脚步未停，脸上依旧是一副闲逛的轻松模样，神识却已如同无形的蛛网般悄然散开，瞬间笼罩了方圆数百丈。
每一个人的气息、动作、甚至细微的情绪波动，都在她感知中清晰呈现。
很快，她锁定了目标。
是两个穿着普通外门弟子服饰、修为在炼气六层左右的青年，正混在人群中，看似随意地闲逛，目光却总会不经意地扫过她，带着一种审慎的、评估的意味。
他们的气息收敛得极好，几乎与普通弟子无异，但云杳杳还是从他们灵力运转的细微习惯和眼神深处的那抹冰冷，看出了一丝不寻常。
这不是青云宗弟子该有的气质。
倒像是…经过严格训练的暗子或杀手。
‘冲我来的？’云杳杳心中冷笑，‘动作倒快。
她不动声色，继续朝着人少的坊市边缘走去，那里有一条僻静的小巷，是回忘忧峰的近路。
果然，那两人也悄无声息地跟了上来。
content_en:
The sudden appearance of the sect's small competition was like throwing a huge boulder on a calm lake, "Senior Sister Yaoyao"
His name completely resounded throughout the inner and outer sects of Qingyun Sect.
The fifth level of Qi Refining easily defeated the seventh level, and he could even casually point out the bottlenecks of the opponent's skills. These methods were far beyond the understanding of ordinary disciples.
Envy, awe, jealousy, exploration...all kinds of eyes intertwined on her unchanging blue dress.
However, Yun Yaoyao didn't care. After the game, he slipped away to the spirit animal park and studied the "sustainable grooming and feeding plan" for the fluffy spirit bird babies for half a day.
, in the end, in the eyes of the deacon disciple of the Spirit Beast Park who was about to cry, he regretfully gave up the idea of adopting a cloud-winged bird chick that looked delicious... very cute, and only bought a few kilograms of the spirit fish, which was said to be of tender meat, and went back to Wangyou Peak for hotpot.
The days seem to have returned to their previous rhythm.
She still wears blue clothes and wanders around the peaks every day, and sometimes goes to the alchemy hall to "optimize"
Danfang (mainly to improve the taste), and sometimes go to Qige for "guidance"
Refining tools (mainly improving kitchen utensils), and sometimes going to Fu Palace to "discuss"
Fu Lu (mainly to increase the convenience of life), occasionally go to the teaching hall to attend lectures, and when I feel sleepy, I will lie on the table and doze off. However, when the elders ask questions, I can still vaguely say some insightful and enlightening insights, which makes the elders of the teachings love and hate me.
The three senior brothers doted on her to no end.
Every three days, Yan Zheng would send her newly refined magic weapons with strange functions (but their shapes were often hard to explain); Shi Meng would make her medicinal diet in different ways; even the cold-faced senior brother Gu Cangming would make an exception and personally give her a few words of guidance when she went to Jin Ting Peak for swordsmanship lessons - although the method was to use sword energy to force her to run around the place, euphemistically called "real combat insights."
Yun Yaoyao enjoys it.
She deliberately restrained all the extraordinary things and purely relied on the cultivation of the fifth level of Qi refining to learn, experience and feel.
She discovered that when she had care and warmth in her heart, and she no longer practiced to become stronger, but to practice to protect this peace, every small breakthrough in the realm, every new understanding of the technique, brought an unprecedented sense of fulfillment and joy.
This is completely different from the feeling of moving forward alone in the first life, with only strength supreme.
However, the big tree attracts the wind.
The more relaxed she appeared, the more secret prying eyes she got.
On this day, she had just come out of the array (to study how to set up a constant temperature preservation array for hot pot), and planned to go to Waimenfang City to see if there were any novel seasonings, but she was keenly aware of a very subtle and malicious sense of peeping.
The feeling disappeared in a flash and was so well hidden that if it weren't for the extremely high nature of her soul, there would be no way of detecting it.
Yun Yaoyao's footsteps did not stop, and his face still looked relaxed as he was strolling around. However, his spiritual consciousness spread quietly like an invisible spider web, covering hundreds of feet in an instant.
Every person's breath, movement, and even subtle emotional fluctuations are clearly presented in her perception.
Soon, she locked onto the target.
They were two young men wearing ordinary outer disciple attire and whose cultivation was around the sixth level of Qi Refining. They were mixing in the crowd, wandering seemingly casually, but their eyes would always glance at her inadvertently, with a cautious and evaluative tone.
Their auras were extremely well controlled, almost no different from ordinary disciples, but Yun Yaoyao still saw something unusual from the subtle habits of their spiritual energy operation and the coldness deep in their eyes.
This is not the temperament that a Qingyun Sect disciple should have.
It's more like...a dark man or killer who has undergone rigorous training.
‘Are you coming for me? ’ Yun Yaoyao sneered in his heart, ‘The action is too fast.
She remained calm and continued walking towards the edge of Fangshi where there were few people. There was a secluded alley there, which was a shortcut back to Wangyou Peak.
Sure enough, the two men followed them quietly.
